intro: Kaya's Alive is a short Horde quest in the Stonetalon Mountains that concludes the rescue of Kaya Flathoof. After escorting the young tauren safely past hostile Grimtotem bandits, you are sent to carry the joyful news of her survival to her worried aunt, Tammra Windfield, in Sun Rock Retreat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, friend.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
